pages.text:
Syntax: bank [command]
                 |
                 |Available commands:
                 |  bank balance        - Display your account balance
                 |  bank deposit <amt>  - Deposit gold into your account
                 |  bank withdraw <amt> - Withdraw gold from your account
                 |  bank sdeposit <amt> - Deposit silver into your account
                 |  bank swithdraw <amt> - Withdraw silver from your account
                 |  bank convert <amt>  - Convert 100 silver to 1 gold
                 |  bank transfer <who> <amt> - Transfer gold to another player
                 |
                 |Banks are open from 9am to 5pm game time. ATMs allow
                 |withdrawals at any hour but have daily limits. Deposits
                 |and transfers are available only during banking hours.
                 |
                 |Use 'nobank' keyword to prevent accidental withdrawals.
